verses.en: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
verses.sm: Aw: e, ua ou valaau atu ia te oe ai mea loloto.

verses.en: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
verses.sm: Le ALII e, ia e faafofoga mai i loʻu leo; ia liliu mai ou fofoga i le leo o laʻu aioi atu.

verses.en: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
verses.sm: Le ALII e, afai e te mataulia le amio leaga, le Alii e, o ai se na te mafaia ona tulai?

verses.en: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
verses.sm: A o ia te oe le faamagaloina o sala, ina ia matautia oe. Ou te faatali atu i le ALII,

verses.en: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
verses.sm: o loo faatali atu lava loʻu agaga; ou te faamoemoe foi i lana afioga.

verses.en: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
verses.sm: O loo faatalitali atu loʻu agaga i le ALII e sili i e o leoleo ona faatalitali i le taeao; e sili lava i e o leoleo ona faatalitali i le taeao.

verses.en: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
verses.sm: la faamoemoe Isaraelu i le ALII; ana o i le ALII le alofa, o ia te ia foi le faaolataga tele.

verses.en: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
verses.sm: O ia lava na te faaolaina Isaraelu ai a latou amio leaga uma lava.
